scope: Literature and modelling catalogue; not callable problem registry
current_theory_note: Separable convex structure is not a certificate of finite-valued full-product-space objective level boundedness; local domains require an extension or independent proof.

entries.title: Towards multiobjective optimization and control of smart grids
entries.limits: Requires local domains; objectives not level bounded on full product space
entries.data: Paper cites Australian load/PV data; not acquired

entries.title: Decentralized and Multi-Objective Coordinated Optimization of Hybrid AC/DC Flexible Distribution Networks
entries.split: x=(regional variables); z=boundary copies; f_i=sum regional costs; g_i=0
entries.coupling: E x - R z = 0; R replicates shared boundary values into regional copies
entries.limits: Original AC power flow and discrete equipment require separate treatment; count boundary loss once
entries.data: Modified dual IEEE 33-bus case; full machine-readable instance not acquired

entries.title: Optimal operation of park-level integrated energy system based on multi-agent cooperative game
entries.split: Catalogue grouping: f=(sum costs in Jx,sum emissions in Jx); g analogous on Jz
entries.coupling: A x + B z = electric_heat_cooling_demand, for fixed conversion efficiencies
entries.limits: Start/stop, exclusivity and nonlinear efficiency may be nonconvex; Shapley allocation is a later step
entries.data: Equipment table and typical-day curves; full machine-readable instance not acquired

entries.title: Distributed Energy Management for Networked Microgrids Embedded Modern Distribution System Using ADMM Algorithm
entries.split: Catalogue candidate only: participants x; DMS z; f_i=sum participant costs; g_i=DMS cost
entries.coupling: P x + B z = nodal_demand (template; not a verified transcription)
entries.limits: Full-text formula and integer/flow constraint audit required; institutional date differs from DOI volume year

entries.title: A parallel algorithm for generating Pareto-optimal radiosurgery treatment plans
entries.split: Catalogue primal template: x=t; z=d; f=(0,0,b(t)); g=(U_T(d),O_N(d),0)
entries.limits: Paper solver splits dual LP with copies; generic primal template is not its exact iteration. Resampling and discrete beam selection require separate models
entries.data: 20 clinical cases reported; dose matrices not acquired

entries.title: Distributed MPC-based Coordination of Traffic Perimeter and Signal Control: A Lexicographic Optimization Approach
entries.split: Catalogue template: x=regional plans; z=boundary flows; f=(-sum inflows,sum regional traffic costs); g=0
entries.coupling: E x - R z = 0; R replicates shared boundary flows into subnetwork copies
entries.limits: Lexicographic priorities must be retained; paper uses proximal distributed ADMM, not an unrestricted Pareto sweep
entries.data: VISSIM/MATLAB simulations; full reproduction package not acquired

entries.title: Multi-objective surrogate optimization of mixed-variable IPM motor design problem with ADMM-based approach
entries.split: x=continuous design representation; z=selected discrete coordinates; f=(-T_hat(x),L_hat(x)); g=0
entries.coupling: S x - z = 0; z in allowed discrete set
entries.limits: STOM scalarization and RBF surrogates; torque ripple was future work, not a third demonstrated objective
entries.data: Design data available from authors on request; FEA needed

entries.title: Cardinality Constrained Portfolio Optimization via Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers
entries.split: Catalogue vectorization: f=(x^T Sigma x,-mu^T x); g=0
entries.limits: Paper uses a scalar tradeoff and a finite quadratic penalty for budget; hard budget variant is distinct; no automatic long-only assumption
entries.data: Real financial datasets reported; time-window data not acquired

entries.title: Fast Image Recovery Using Variable Splitting and Constrained Optimization
entries.limits: Paper is scalar regularization; derivative boundary/grouping must be fixed; zero block costs fail full-space level boundedness
entries.data: Use licensed images with recorded blur/noise/boundaries; no real data bundled

entries.title: Robust Principal Component Analysis?
entries.loc: Principal component pursuit model; ADMM background in Boyd et al. 2011
entries.limits: Vector objective is a catalogue extension of scalar PCP; adding dense noise does not justify arbitrary three-block ADMM
entries.data: No human image/video data bundled; hand-computable small matrix fixture

entries.title: Total Variation Spatial Regularization for Sparse Hyperspectral Unmixing
entries.limits: Full publisher text not audited; nonnegativity plus sum-to-one makes l1 abundance constant. Joint dictionary estimation is nonconvex
entries.data: Dictionary, bands, TV boundary and imagery licensing must be recorded; no real imagery bundled

entries.title: Multi-Period Trading via Convex Optimization
entries.loc: Author page and linked full text; single-period trading model
entries.split: Single-period catalogue simplification: f=(x^T Sigma x,-mu^T x,0); g=(0,0,||z||_1)
entries.limits: New vectorization/split; excludes full multi-period cash, fees and market-impact accounting; linear objective not coercive
entries.data: No market data bundled; explicit synthetic covariance/mean/holdings fixture
